item.description:
• Replays now recreate the original take: the recorded style, colors and full-stage effects, without touching your current settings
  • Recordings now capture full-stage key effects and replay them
  • Fixed key positions: rows 2–4 now line up with the real keys, and Return no longer falls off screen
  • Installer size cut in half (about 4 MB) for faster downloads and updates
  • Stability improvements and internal cleanup

• 回放还原「当时那一场」：按录制时的风格、配色与全场效果重现，不改动当前设置
  • 录制会记下全场键效果，回放时一并重现
  • 修正键位位置：第二到第四排的光与实际按键对齐，回车不再超出屏幕
  • 安装包体积减半（约 4MB），启动与更新更快
  • 稳定性与内部清理
